'use strict';
__ORIGIN__
// __NAME_TEXT__ (__BASE_TEXT__). Generated by tools/source-lab.js (generate) from the Madara template of the project: the site is built on
// the Madara WordPress theme, whose pages have a documented shape (docs/adicionar-source-completo.md). Nothing was copied from
// another app. What the generator measured on the site is in the header of the generated report, not in this file.

const cheerio = require('cheerio');
const { fetchText, DEFAULT_USER_AGENT } = require('../../server/modules/network/fetch-utils');
const { safeFetch } = require('../../server/modules/network/safe-fetch');
const { normalizeStatus } = require('../../server/modules/common/manga-status');
const { proxyImageUrl: proxyImg } = require('../../server/modules/common/image-proxy');
const { parseChapterDate, isRelativeDate } = require('../../server/modules/source-import/chapter-dates');

const BASE = __BASE__;
const DATE_ORDER = __DATE_ORDER__; // how a numeric date is read when no day settles it (dmy, mdy or ymd), measured on the site
const SUB = __SUBPATH__; // the folder the site keeps its titles in ("manga" on most installs; the generator reads it from the site)
const SITE = __NAME__;
const GENRE_SLUGS = __GENRE_SLUGS__; // lower-case genre name -> slug of /manga-genre/<slug>/
const NEVER_GENRE_SLUGS = __NEVER_SLUGS__; // the site's own never-listed genres: their titles are kept out of every list
const TEXT_SEARCH = __TEXT_SEARCH__; // false when robots.txt forbids the site's text search: the source then scans the list pages
// Categories that are never listed. Matched at the start of each word, so a rename or a multi-word name is caught too.
const NEVER_LISTED_RE = /(^|[^a-z])(loli|shota|toddler)/i;
const MANGA_ID_RE = /^[\w-]+$/;
const TITLE_PATH_RE = new RegExp(`/${SUB}/([^/?#]+)`);
const CHAPTER_PATH_RE = new RegExp(`/${SUB}/([^/?#]+/[^?#]+?)/?(?:[?#]|$)`);
const CHAPTER_ID_RE = /^(?!.*\.\.)[\w-]+(?:\/[\w.-]+){1,3}$/;
const PLACEHOLDER_RE = /(^|[/_.-])(loading|placeholder|spinner|lazy|blank|preloader)([/_.-]|\d|$)/i;
const ORDER = { relevance: 'latest', latestUploadedChapter: 'latest', views: 'views', followedCount: 'trending', rating: 'rating', title: 'alphabet' };
const CARDS = '.c-tabs-item__content, .page-item-detail, .manga-item';
const SCAN_PAGES = 15;

// A chapter the site keeps for subscribers or for later (a lock plugin): not a missing chapter, and not readable.
const LOCKED_RE = /\b(locked|unlock|premium|paywall|early access|members only|vip)\b/i;

// What a person would read on a page (no scripts or styles): where a lock plugin puts its "this chapter is locked" message.
function visibleText($) {
  const body = $('body').clone();
  body.find('script, style, noscript').remove();
  return body.text().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').slice(0, 20000);
}

function httpError(message, statusCode) {
  const e = new Error(message);
  e.statusCode = statusCode;
  return e;
}

// One request where 404 is a normal answer: no retries (guide, section 3).
async function fetchPage(url) {
  let html;
  try {
    html = await fetchText(url, 0);
  } catch (err) {
    if (/^HTTP 404$/.test(err.message)) throw httpError('not found', 404);
    throw new Error(`${SITE}: ${err.message}`, { cause: err });
  }
  if (/<title>\s*Just a moment/i.test(html)) throw new Error('the site asked for an anti-bot check (known limit)');
  return html;
}

// What the theme's own script does to fill in a chapter list: a POST with no body and the XMLHttpRequest header.
async function postHtml(url) {
  const res = await safeFetch(url, {
    method: 'POST',
    redirect: 'follow',
    signal: AbortSignal.timeout(20000),
    headers: { 'User-Agent': DEFAULT_USER_AGENT, 'X-Requested-With': 'XMLHttpRequest', Referer: `${BASE}/`, Accept: 'text/html,*/*' },
  });
  if (res.status === 404) throw httpError('not found', 404);
  if (!res.ok) throw new Error(`${SITE}: HTTP ${res.status}`);
  return res.text();
}

function absUrl(u = '') {
  const s = String(u).trim();
  if (!s || /^data:/i.test(s)) return '';
  if (/^https?:\/\//i.test(s)) return s;
  if (s.startsWith('//')) return `https:${s}`;
  return BASE + (s.startsWith('/') ? s : `/${s}`);
}

function imgSrc($img) {
  return absUrl($img.attr('data-src') || $img.attr('data-lazy-src') || $img.attr('data-cfsrc') || $img.attr('src') || '');
}

function plainText(html) {
  const once = cheerio.load(`<div>${html || ''}</div>`).text();
  return /&(?:#\d+|#x[\da-f]+|[a-z]+);/i.test(once) ? cheerio.load(`<div>${once}</div>`).text().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim() : once.replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
}

// The printed date of a chapter as an ISO date ("3 days ago", "Mar 4, 2026", "04/03/2026", the same in the other main languages): or null, never invented.
function toIso(text, now = Date.now()) {
  return parseChapterDate(text, { order: DATE_ORDER, now });
}

// If 4 or more chapters share the same UTC hour it is not a publication time: null (never an invented date).
function cleanPublishDates(timestamps) {
  const perHour = new Map();
  const ms = timestamps.map((t) => Date.parse(t));
  ms.forEach((t) => { if (Number.isFinite(t)) perHour.set(Math.floor(t / 3600000), (perHour.get(Math.floor(t / 3600000)) || 0) + 1); });
  return ms.map((t) => (!Number.isFinite(t) || perHour.get(Math.floor(t / 3600000)) > 3 ? null : new Date(t).toISOString()));
}

// ---- list pages ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------
function empty() {
  return { results: [], hasNextPage: false };
}

function parseCards($) {
  const results = [];
  const seen = new Set();
  $(CARDS).each((_, el) => {
    const a = $(el).find('.post-title a, h3 a, h5 a').first();
    const m = String(a.attr('href') || '').match(TITLE_PATH_RE);
    const id = m ? decodeURIComponent(m[1]) : '';
    if (!id || seen.has(id) || !MANGA_ID_RE.test(id)) return;
    const genres = $(el).find('.mg_genres a, .genres a').map((__, g) => $(g).text().trim()).get().filter(Boolean);
    if (genres.some((g) => NEVER_LISTED_RE.test(g))) return;
    seen.add(id);
    const cover = imgSrc($(el).find('img').first());
    results.push({
      id,
      title: a.text().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim() || a.attr('title') || id,
      cover: cover ? proxyImg(cover) : '',
      url: `${BASE}/${SUB}/${id}`,
      genres,
      status: 'unknown',
      author: '',
    });
  });
  return results;
}

// Most installs have a pager, some only a "load more" button (the page is then reached by /page/N/ all the same).
function hasNext($, page) {
  return $('.nextpostslink, a.next.page-numbers, .nav-previous a, .load-ajax, [class*="load-more"], #navigation-ajax').length > 0 || $(`a[href*="/page/${page + 1}/"]`).length > 0;
}

// A page past the end is a 404 on this theme: nothing, not an error.
async function listPage(url, page) {
  try {
    return cheerio.load(await fetchPage(url));
  } catch (err) {
    if (page > 1 && err.statusCode === 404) return null;
    throw err;
  }
}

function expectListPage($) {
  if (!$(CARDS).length && !$('.c-page-content, .search-wrap, .page-listing-item').length) throw new Error(`${SITE}: the list page has an unexpected shape`);
}

async function rawBrowse({ page = 1, order = 'latest', genreSlug = '' }) {
  const p = Math.max(1, Number(page) || 1);
  const root = genreSlug ? `${BASE}/manga-genre/${genreSlug}/` : `${BASE}/${SUB}/`;
  const url = `${root}${p > 1 ? `page/${p}/` : ''}?m_orderby=${order}`;
  const $ = await listPage(url, p);
  if (!$) return empty();
  expectListPage($);
  return { results: parseCards($), hasNextPage: hasNext($, p) };
}

// The titles of the site's never-listed genres (read from their own genre pages), kept six hours. A list card carries no genres, so
// this is what keeps such a title out of every list and search. If a genre page cannot be read the source refuses to list, rather
// than list without the exclusion.
let neverCache = null; // { t, ids }
async function neverIds() {
  if (!NEVER_GENRE_SLUGS.length) return new Set();
  if (neverCache && Date.now() - neverCache.t < 6 * 3600 * 1000) return neverCache.ids;
  const ids = new Set();
  for (const slug of NEVER_GENRE_SLUGS) {
    for (let page = 1; page <= 10; page += 1) {
      let list;
      try { list = await rawBrowse({ page, order: 'latest', genreSlug: slug }); } catch (err) { if (err.statusCode === 404) break; throw err; }
      list.results.forEach((r) => ids.add(r.id));
      if (!list.hasNextPage || !list.results.length) break;
    }
  }
  neverCache = { t: Date.now(), ids };
  return ids;
}

async function withoutNever(list) {
  const never = await neverIds();
  return never.size ? { ...list, results: list.results.filter((r) => !never.has(r.id)) } : list;
}

async function browse(options) {
  return withoutNever(await rawBrowse(options));
}

async function textSearch(query, page) {
  const p = Math.max(1, Number(page) || 1);
  const q = encodeURIComponent(query);
  const url = p === 1 ? `${BASE}/?s=${q}&post_type=wp-manga` : `${BASE}/page/${p}/?s=${q}&post_type=wp-manga`;
  const $ = await listPage(url, p);
  if (!$) return empty();
  expectListPage($);
  return withoutNever({ results: parseCards($), hasNextPage: hasNext($, p) });
}

// robots.txt forbids the text search: the titles of the list pages are read once (A to Z, at most SCAN_PAGES pages) and kept for
// half an hour, and the search filters that index.
let titleIndex = null; // { t, items }
async function scanSearch(query) {
  if (!titleIndex || Date.now() - titleIndex.t > 30 * 60 * 1000) {
    const items = [];
    for (let page = 1; page <= SCAN_PAGES; page += 1) {
      const list = await browse({ page, order: 'alphabet' });
      items.push(...list.results);
      if (!list.hasNextPage) break;
    }
    titleIndex = { t: Date.now(), items };
  }
  const needle = query.toLowerCase();
  return { results: titleIndex.items.filter((r) => r.title.toLowerCase().includes(needle)), hasNextPage: false };
}

module.exports = {
  meta: {
    id: __ID__, name: __NAME__, version: '1.0.0', author: 'generated',
    supportsPopularAllTime: true,
    supportsRecentlyAdded: false,
    ui: {
      filters: {
        orderBy: [
          { value: 'relevance', label: 'Latest Updated' },
          { value: 'views', label: 'Most Viewed' },
          { value: 'followedCount', label: 'Trending' },
          { value: 'rating', label: 'Rating' },
          { value: 'title', label: 'Name A-Z' },
        ],
        publicationStatus: false,
        contentRating: false,
        format: false,
        genres: true,
      },
      genres: __GENRES__,
      nsfwGenres: __NSFW__,
      nativeDates: __NATIVE_DATES__,
      adultOnly: __ADULT_ONLY__, // every title of the site is adult: Hide NSFW hides the whole source
    },
  },

  // Text search, or the site's own list (sorted when the app asks). Neither can be combined with a genre on this theme.
  async search(query, page = 1, orderBy = '') {
    const q = String(query || '').trim();
    if (q && NEVER_LISTED_RE.test(q)) return empty();
    if (q) return TEXT_SEARCH ? textSearch(q, page) : scanSearch(q);
    return browse({ page, order: ORDER[orderBy] || ORDER.relevance });
  },

  // The theme lists one genre at a time: the first requested one (a never-listed name, or a genre the site does not have, is nothing).
  async byGenres(genres, orderBy = '', _filters = {}, page = 1) {
    const names = (Array.isArray(genres) ? genres : [genres]).map((g) => String(g || '').trim()).filter(Boolean);
    if (!names.length || names.some((g) => NEVER_LISTED_RE.test(g))) return empty();
    const slug = GENRE_SLUGS[names[0].toLowerCase()];
    if (!slug) return empty();
    const list = await browse({ page, order: ORDER[orderBy] || ORDER.relevance, genreSlug: slug });
    return { results: list.results.map((c) => ({ ...c, genres: c.genres.length ? c.genres : [names[0]] })), hasNextPage: list.hasNextPage };
  },

  async trending() {
    return { results: (await browse({ order: 'trending' })).results };
  },

  async latestUpdates() {
    return { results: (await browse({ order: 'latest' })).results };
  },

  async popularAllTime() {
    return { results: (await browse({ order: 'views' })).results };
  },

  async mangaDetails(mangaId) {
    const id = String(mangaId || '');
    if (!MANGA_ID_RE.test(id)) throw httpError('invalid title id', 400);
    const $ = cheerio.load(await fetchPage(`${BASE}/${SUB}/${id}/`));
    const heading = $('.post-title h1, .post-title h3').first().clone();
    heading.find('span, .manga-title-badges').remove();
    const title = heading.text().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
    if (!title) throw httpError(`"${id}" not found`, 404); // a 200 that is not a title page
    const genres = $('.genres-content a').map((_, a) => $(a).text().trim()).get().filter(Boolean);
    if (genres.some((g) => NEVER_LISTED_RE.test(g)) || (await neverIds()).has(id)) throw httpError(`"${id}" not found`, 404);
    let rawStatus = '';
    $('.post-content_item').each((_, item) => {
      if (/status/i.test($(item).find('.summary-heading').text())) rawStatus = $(item).find('.summary-content').text().trim();
    });
    return {
      id,
      title,
      cover: proxyImg(imgSrc($('.summary_image img').first())),
      description: plainText($('.description-summary .summary__content, .summary__content').first().html()),
      status: normalizeStatus(rawStatus),
      genres,
      author: $('.author-content a').map((_, a) => $(a).text().trim()).get().filter(Boolean).join(', '),
      url: `${BASE}/${SUB}/${id}/`,
    };
  },

  async chapters(mangaId) {
    const id = String(mangaId || '');
    if (!MANGA_ID_RE.test(id)) throw httpError('invalid title id', 400);
    // The list is in the title page on some installs and fetched by a POST on others: the page first, the call if it has none.
    let $ = cheerio.load(await fetchPage(`${BASE}/${SUB}/${id}/`));
    if (!$('.post-title').length && !$('li.wp-manga-chapter').length) throw httpError(`"${id}" not found`, 404);
    if ($('.genres-content a').map((_, a) => $(a).text()).get().some((g) => NEVER_LISTED_RE.test(g)) || (await neverIds()).has(id)) throw httpError(`"${id}" not found`, 404);
    if (!$('li.wp-manga-chapter').length) $ = cheerio.load(await postHtml(`${BASE}/${SUB}/${id}/ajax/chapters/`));
    const now = Date.now();
    const chapters = [];
    const rawDates = [];
    const dayOnly = [];
    const seen = new Set();
    $('li.wp-manga-chapter').each((_, li) => {
      const a = $(li).find('a').first();
      const m = String(a.attr('href') || '').match(CHAPTER_PATH_RE);
      if (!m || seen.has(m[1]) || !CHAPTER_ID_RE.test(m[1])) return;
      seen.add(m[1]);
      const name = a.text().replace(/\s+/g, ' ').trim();
      const num = (name.match(/(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)/) || [])[1] || '';
      chapters.push({ id: m[1], name, title: name, chapter: num, url: `${BASE}/${SUB}/${m[1]}/`, publishAt: null, pages: [] });
      const dateText = $(li).find('.chapter-release-date').text();
      rawDates.push(toIso(dateText, now));
      dayOnly.push(!isRelativeDate(dateText));
    });
    if (!chapters.length) throw new Error(`${SITE}: no chapter list found`);
    // A date that is only a day keeps its day (several chapters can come out on one day); a time of day shared by four or more
    // chapters is a batch import, not a publication time.
    const cleaned = cleanPublishDates(rawDates);
    chapters.forEach((c, i) => { c.publishAt = dayOnly[i] ? rawDates[i] : cleaned[i]; });
    return { chapters }; // newest first, as the site lists them
  },

  async pages(chapterId) {
    const id = String(chapterId || '');
    if (!CHAPTER_ID_RE.test(id)) throw httpError('invalid chapter id', 400); // also refuses ../../etc/passwd
    const $ = cheerio.load(await fetchPage(`${BASE}/${SUB}/${id}/?style=list`));
    const pages = [];
    $('.reading-content img').each((_, img) => {
      const src = imgSrc($(img));
      if (src && !PLACEHOLDER_RE.test(src.split('?')[0])) pages.push({ index: pages.length, img: proxyImg(src) });
    });
    if (!pages.length) {
      if ($('[class*="lock"]').length || LOCKED_RE.test(visibleText($))) throw httpError(`chapter "${id}" is locked on the site`, 403);
      throw httpError(`chapter "${id}" not found`, 404); // 200 with the title page or the home page
    }
    return { pages };
  },
};
